method: Eight sampled newborn frames and twelve each for handover and return; not frame-by-frame playback.

newborn.note: Same couple in correct home outfits, supported newborn, close hand grip. Newborn is their daughter. No major sampled anatomy defect.

handover.note: Single inherited pair passed to teen daughter; father in blue shirt and brown loafers, lace gesture and shared smiles. Badge placement/product stitching varies slightly from the master.

return.note: Luna and Mom remain distinct; original charcoal/olive wardrobe and low ponytail, photo returns to aged case, Mom reaction after offscreen line. Small right-side shoe repair visible. No duplicate grandfather or supernatural figure.
